cases.sentence: Внешние ___ Алексея Александровича с женою были такие же, как и прежде.
cases.translation: Alexei Alexandrovich's outward relations with his wife were the same as before.
cases.explain: «Отношения» is the subject of «были», so it stands in the Nominative case (plural).

cases.sentence: Он с открытием весны поехал на воды за границу поправлять свое расстраиваемое ежегодно усиленным зимним ___ здоровье.
cases.translation: With the coming of spring he went abroad to take the waters, to repair his health, which was worn down every year by his intensified winter labor.
cases.explain: The Instrumental expresses the means/cause («расстраиваемое трудом», worn down by labor), hence «трудом».

cases.sentence: Со времени того разговора после вечера у ___ Тверской он никогда не говорил с Анной о своих подозрениях.
cases.translation: Since that conversation after the evening at Princess Tverskaya's, he had never spoken to Anna about his suspicions.
cases.explain: The preposition «у» (at someone's place) governs the Genitive case, hence «княгини».

cases.sentence: Он в душе своей закрыл, запер и запечатал тот ___, в котором у него находились его чувства к семье.
cases.translation: In his soul he closed, locked, and sealed that box in which his feelings for his family were kept.
cases.explain: «Закрыл, запер и запечатал» are transitive verbs taking a direct object in the Accusative, hence «ящик».

cases.sentence: От этого-то и было в выражении лица Алексея Александровича что-то гордое и строгое, когда у него спрашивали про здоровье его ___.
cases.translation: That was why there was something proud and stern in Alexei Alexandrovich's expression whenever he was asked about his wife's health.
cases.explain: «Здоровье жены» (the wife's health) expresses possession, requiring the Genitive «жены».

cases.sentence: В нынешнем году графиня Лидия Ивановна отказалась жить в ___.
cases.translation: This year Countess Lydia Ivanovna refused to spend the summer in Petergof.
cases.explain: The preposition «в» (in, location) governs the Prepositional case, hence «Петергофе».

cases.sentence: Алексей Александрович строго остановил ее, высказав мысль, что жена его выше ___.
cases.translation: Alexei Alexandrovich sternly stopped her, expressing the thought that his wife was above suspicion.
cases.explain: The expression «выше чего» (above something) governs the Genitive case, hence «подозрения».

cases.sentence: Управляющий делами только передал нужные для Алексея Александровича ___.
cases.translation: The estate manager only handed over the money that Alexei Alexandrovich needed.
cases.explain: «Передал» (handed over) is a transitive verb taking a direct object in the Accusative, hence «деньги».

cases.translation: The doctor found the liver considerably enlarged.
cases.explain: «Нашел» (found) is a transitive verb taking a direct object in the Accusative, hence «печень».

cases.sentence: Доктор столкнулся на крыльце с хорошо знакомым ему ___.
cases.translation: On the porch the doctor ran into Slyudin, who was well known to him.
cases.explain: The preposition «с» (with, meeting someone) governs the Instrumental case, hence «Слюдиным».

cases.translation: He is stretched to the last degree.
cases.explain: The preposition «до» (up to) governs the Genitive case, hence «степени».

reading.ru: Внешние отношения Алексея Александровича с женою были такие же, как и прежде.
reading.question: How did Karenin's outward relations with Anna appear?
reading.correct: Unchanged from before
reading.explain: The text states his outward relations with his wife remained the same as before.

reading.ru: Единственная разница состояла в том, что он еще более был занят, чем прежде.
reading.question: What was the one difference in Karenin's behavior?
options: He was even busier than before
reading.correct: He was even busier than before
reading.explain: The only difference was that he was even more occupied than before.

reading.ru: Как и в прежние года, он с открытием весны поехал на воды за границу поправлять свое расстраиваемое ежегодно усиленным зимним трудом здоровье.
reading.question: Why did Karenin go abroad each spring?
options: To take the waters and restore his health, worn down by winter work
To attend to Anna's family estate
reading.correct: To take the waters and restore his health, worn down by winter work
reading.explain: With spring's arrival he went abroad to take the waters to repair his health, strained yearly by intensive winter work.

reading.ru: Со времени того разговора после вечера у княгини Тверской он никогда не говорил с Анной о своих подозрениях и ревности.
reading.question: What had Karenin avoided discussing with Anna since the evening at Princess Tverskaya's?
reading.correct: His suspicions and jealousy
reading.explain: Since that conversation, he had never again spoken with Anna about his suspicions and jealousy.

reading.ru: Он только как будто имел на нее маленькое неудовольствие за тот первый ночной разговор, который она отклонила от себя».
reading.question: What lingering feeling did Karenin seem to have toward Anna?
options: A slight displeasure over her having deflected their earlier night conversation
reading.correct: A slight displeasure over her having deflected their earlier night conversation
reading.explain: He seemed to hold a small grudge against her for having brushed off that first nighttime conversation.

reading.ru: Он, этот умный и тонкий в служебных делах человек, не понимал всего безумия такого отношения к жене.
reading.question: What irony does the narrator note about Karenin?
options: Though sharp in official affairs, he failed to see the madness of his attitude toward his wife
He was equally foolish in both his work and his marriage
He understood his marriage perfectly but ignored it
He was incompetent at his job but wise at home
reading.correct: Though sharp in official affairs, he failed to see the madness of his attitude toward his wife
reading.explain: The narrator notes that this man, clever and subtle in official matters, didn't grasp the full madness of his approach to his wife.

reading.ru: И он в душе своей закрыл, запер и запечатал тот ящик, в котором у него находились его чувства к семье, то есть к жене и сыну.
reading.question: How did Karenin deal with his feelings about his family?
options: He sealed them away like a locked box in his soul
He expressed them openly to friends
He wrote them in a diary
He discussed them with his doctor
reading.correct: He sealed them away like a locked box in his soul
reading.explain: In his soul he closed, locked, and sealed the box holding his feelings toward his wife and son.

reading.ru: Он, внимательный отец, с конца этой зимы стал особенно холоден к сыну и имел к нему тоже подтрунивающее отношение, как и к жене.
reading.question: How had Karenin's attitude toward his son changed?
options: He became especially cold and mockingly teasing toward him
He became overly affectionate and indulgent
He ignored him completely, never speaking to him
He sent him away to boarding school
reading.correct: He became especially cold and mockingly teasing toward him
reading.explain: Since late winter he had become especially cold toward his son, treating him with the same teasing manner as his wife.

reading.ru: Алексей Александрович думал и говорил, что ни в какой год у него не было столько служебного дела, как в нынешний.
reading.question: What did Karenin claim about his workload this year?
options: That he had never had so much official work as this year
That his workload had decreased significantly
That he planned to retire soon
That his colleagues were doing his work for him
reading.correct: That he had never had so much official work as this year
reading.explain: He thought and said that in no other year had he had so much official business as this year.

reading.ru: Но он не сознавал того, что он сам выдумывал себе в нынешнем году дела, что это было одно из средств не открывать того ящика, где лежали чувства к жене и семье, и мысли о них, и которые делались тем страшнее, чем дольше они там лежали.
reading.question: What did Karenin fail to recognize about his own workload?
options: That he was inventing extra work for himself to avoid confronting his feelings
That his workload was assigned by his superiors
That his wife had asked him to work more
That his doctor recommended more work
reading.correct: That he was inventing extra work for himself to avoid confronting his feelings
reading.explain: He didn't realize that he himself invented extra business this year as a means of not opening the box holding his feelings toward his wife and family.

reading.ru: В нынешнем году графиня Лидия Ивановна отказалась жить в Петергофе, ни разу не была у Анны Аркадьевны и намекнула Алексею Александровичу на неудобство сближения Анны с Бетси и Вронским.
reading.question: What did Countess Lydia Ivanovna do differently this year regarding Anna?
options: She refused to summer in Petergof and hinted at concerns about Anna's closeness with Betsy and Vronsky
She moved in with Anna to keep her company
She openly accused Anna of infidelity
She invited Anna to travel abroad with her
reading.correct: She refused to summer in Petergof and hinted at concerns about Anna's closeness with Betsy and Vronsky
reading.explain: This year the countess refused to live in Petergof, never visited Anna, and hinted to Karenin about the impropriety of Anna's closeness with Betsy and Vronsky.

reading.ru: Алексей Александрович строго остановил ее, высказав мысль, что жена его выше подозрения, и с тех пор стал избегать графини Лидии Ивановны.
reading.question: How did Karenin respond to Lydia Ivanovna's hint?
options: He sternly rebuffed her, insisting his wife was above suspicion, then began avoiding her
He thanked her for the warning and investigated immediately
He agreed and confronted Anna at once
He asked her to keep watching Anna closely
reading.correct: He sternly rebuffed her, insisting his wife was above suspicion, then began avoiding her
reading.explain: Karenin sternly stopped her, declaring his wife was above suspicion, and afterward began avoiding the countess.

reading.ru: Он не позволял себе думать об этом и не думал.
reading.question: How did Karenin handle uncomfortable thoughts about Anna's behavior?
options: He refused to allow himself to think about it, and simply didn't
He confided them to his doctor
He wrote them down in letters
reading.correct: He refused to allow himself to think about it, and simply didn't
reading.explain: He did not permit himself to think about it, and indeed he did not.

reading.ru: Но вместе с тем он в глубине своей души, никогда не высказывая этого самому себе и не имея на то никаких не только доказательств, но и подозрений, знал несомненно, что он был обманутый муж и был от этого глубоко несчастлив.
reading.question: What did Karenin secretly know deep in his soul?
options: That he was a deceived husband, and it made him deeply unhappy
That his career was about to end
That his wife planned to leave him legally
That Vronsky intended to challenge him to a duel
reading.correct: That he was a deceived husband, and it made him deeply unhappy
reading.explain: Deep in his soul, he knew without doubt that he was a deceived husband and was deeply unhappy because of it.

reading.ru: Но теперь, когда беда пала на его голову, он не только не думал о том, как развязать это положение, но вовсе не хотел знать его, не хотел знать именно потому, что оно было слишком ужасно, слишком неестественно.
reading.question: How did Karenin react now that misfortune had actually befallen him?
options: He didn't want to think about resolving it or even acknowledge it
He immediately sought a divorce lawyer
He asked Anna for a full confession
reading.correct: He didn't want to think about resolving it or even acknowledge it
reading.explain: Now that the trouble had actually fallen on him, he not only avoided thinking how to resolve it but didn't want to acknowledge it at all.

reading.ru: Кроме того, в этот день ему нужно было передать жене к пятнадцатому числу по заведенному порядку на расход деньги».
reading.question: What practical task did Karenin need to complete regarding Anna that day?
options: Give her the household allowance money as usual, by the fifteenth
Deliver a letter from Lydia Ivanovna
reading.correct: Give her the household allowance money as usual, by the fifteenth
reading.explain: That day he needed to give his wife her usual household expense money by the fifteenth, as was customary.

reading.ru: Накануне графиня Лидия Ивановна прислала ему брошюру бывшего в Петербурге знаменитого путешественника в Китае с письмом, прося его принять самого путешественника, человека по разным соображениям весьма интересного и нужного.
reading.question: What did Countess Lydia Ivanovna send Karenin the day before?
options: A pamphlet by a famous traveler to China, asking him to receive the traveler
A love letter from a secret admirer
A medical report about his health
reading.correct: A pamphlet by a famous traveler to China, asking him to receive the traveler
reading.explain: The countess had sent a pamphlet by a well-known traveler to China, along with a letter asking Karenin to receive him.

reading.ru: Но доктор, знаменитый петербургский доктор, находившийся в приятельских отношениях к Алексею Александровичу, занял много времени.
reading.question: Who visited Karenin and took up much of his time that morning?
options: A famous Petersburg doctor, on friendly terms with him
reading.correct: A famous Petersburg doctor, on friendly terms with him
reading.explain: A famous Petersburg doctor, who was on friendly terms with him, took up a great deal of his time.

reading.ru: Алексей Александрович не знал, что его друг Лидия Ивановна, заметив, что здоровье Алексея Александровича нынешний год нехорошо, просила доктора приехать и посмотреть больного.
reading.question: Why had the doctor actually come to see Karenin?
options: Lydia Ivanovna had asked him to check on Karenin's declining health
Karenin had summoned him for a routine checkup
The doctor came uninvited out of curiosity
reading.correct: Lydia Ivanovna had asked him to check on Karenin's declining health
reading.explain: Unknown to Karenin, his friend Lydia Ivanovna, noticing his health was poor this year, had asked the doctor to come examine him.

reading.ru: Он нашел печень значительно увеличенную, питание уменьшенным и действия вот никакого.
reading.question: What did the doctor find wrong with Karenin?
options: An enlarged liver, decreased nourishment, and diminished vitality
Nothing at all; he was perfectly healthy
reading.correct: An enlarged liver, decreased nourishment, and diminished vitality
reading.explain: The doctor found the liver considerably enlarged, nutrition diminished, and no vital response.

reading.ru: «Не натягивайте струны и попробуйте перервать. Очень трудно. Но натяните до последней возможности и наляжьте тяжестью пальца на натянутую струну. Она лопнет».
reading.question: What metaphor did the doctor use to describe Karenin's condition to Slyudin?
options: A string stretched to its limit will snap under the slightest added pressure
A ship sailing into a storm
A house built on a poor foundation
A clock that has stopped ticking
reading.correct: A string stretched to its limit will snap under the slightest added pressure
reading.explain: The doctor compared Karenin to a taut string, hard to break normally, but one that snaps if stretched to its limit and pressed further.

reading.ru: Алексей Александрович только успел вернуться к пяти часам времени своего обеда и, пообедав с правителем дел, пригласил его с собой вместе ехать на дачу и на скачки.
reading.question: What did Karenin do after his busy morning of appointments?
options: He dined at five and invited his office manager to join him at the dacha and races
He canceled his trip to the dacha entirely
He went straight to bed exhausted
reading.correct: He dined at five and invited his office manager to join him at the dacha and races
reading.explain: He only managed to return by five for dinner, and after dining with his office manager invited him along to the dacha and the races.

reading.ru: Не отдавая себе в том отчета, Алексей Александрович искал теперь случая иметь третье лицо при своих свиданиях с женою.
reading.question: What was Karenin unconsciously seeking regarding his visits to Anna?
options: An opportunity to have a third person present during their meetings
A reason to avoid seeing her altogether
A witness to catch her in wrongdoing
Someone to deliver messages between them
reading.correct: An opportunity to have a third person present during their meetings
reading.explain: Without fully realizing it himself, Karenin was now seeking occasions to have a third person present at his meetings with his wife.
